args.reason: The --dry-run DoD item serves the inspection goal, but the other two DoD items go beyond the declared goals. A persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, and an --explain timeline with --since and --format, are historical storage and query features, which the first PRD goal explicitly puts outside this PRD. No other declared goal covers them. The Phase-1 claim that history is a natural extension of inspection ignores that exclusion: the goal is to inspect the current decision, not past ones. Appending history on every real merge-gate evaluation also widens the merge path beyond what any goal asks for.
